## Choices

The labelled values of every closed or model setting above.

??? note "`energy.emission_model`"

 | Value | Label | Meaning |
 |---|---|---|
 | `energy/emission/hbefa3` | Hbefa3 | Tailpipe CO2, CO, HC, NOx, PM and fuel of a combustion-engined vehicle from its speed, acceleration and the road grade, by the polynomial fit of the HBEFA 3.1 emission factors (Krajzewicz et al. |
 | `energy/emission/moves-opmode` | Moves opmode | Tailpipe CO2, CO, HC, NOx, PM2.5 and fuel of a light-duty vehicle by the US EPA MOVES method: each interval is binned into one of 23 running operating modes by speed and scaled tractive power, and … |
 | `energy/emission/phemlight` | Phemlight | Tailpipe CO2, CO, HC, NOx, PM and fuel of a passenger car from the engine power its road-load and inertia demand, read off measured emission curves against normalised power (PHEMlight, TU Graz). |
